name: eonsii_triangle_paranal
label: EON-SII triangle (Paranal / CTAO-South)
notes: The pair plus a hypothetical third identical unit on an equilateral triangle: EON-1 at the origin, EON-2 at position angle pa_deg (E of N), EON-3 at pa_deg + 60.
Paranal because the southern targets (delta Vel, dec -54.7) never rise usefully at Teide.
